_about: Hand-maintained. Standing shoulder height as a fraction of head-body length, used to scale the limb chains of the exact profile named (never inherited). Unlike measured.json these are SECONDARY sources: published field ranges in cm, not specimen measurements. 'ratio' is the midpoint of shoulder_cm over the midpoint of head_body_cm from the same source, or the mean of the listed pairs. Retrieved 2026-11-12. Replace with specimen data (limb bone lengths) when available. Pig is deliberately absent: the only figures found were wild boar maxima, which made the domestic pig profile look stilted.

fox.note: sources disagree widely on red fox size

lion.source: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance Library, Lion fact sheet (female and male pairs; head-body values are range midpoints)

deer.source: Wikipedia, Red deer (Scottish hind and stag averages)
